1	# Boldteq Org Structure v2 — Department + Sub-Department Hierarchy
2	
3	**Date:** 2026-04-27
4	**Owner:** rex (strategic) + cadence (HR custodian)
5	**Replaces:** flat 6-department structure (executive / engineering / creative / growth / research / hr)
6	**Scope target:** scale 42 agents → 100+ without losing clarity
7	**Source of truth fields:** `~/.claude/org/registry.json` per-agent `department` + `subDepartment` + `pod` (optional)
8	
9	---
10	
11	## Why this exists
12	
13	At 42 agents the flat 6-department view already mixes incompatible functions: "creative" bundles design + copy + SEO, "engineering" mixes 3 stack pods + platform + architecture + quality. As Boldteq scales toward 100+ agents the flat view becomes unreadable. This document defines the canonical hierarchy: **Department → Sub-Department → Pod (optional) → Specialist**.
14	
15	---
16	
17	## The 7 Departments
18	
19	| # | Department | Lead | Sub-departments | Current size | Target @ 100 |
20	|---|-----------|------|-----------------|--------------|--------------|
21	| 1 | `executive` | rex | — | 1 | 1-2 |
22	| 2 | `engineering` | arya | pod-a, pod-b, pod-c, platform, architecture, quality | 13 | 30+ |
23	| 3 | `design` | vega | public-pages, ecom, dashboard, design-system, deliverables | 5 | 12+ |
24	| 4 | `content-seo` | quill | marketing-copy, cro-copy, lifecycle-email, app-store, developer-docs, seo | 5 | 12+ |

282	## Scaling Rules
283	
284	### When to add a sub-department
285	- A sub-department exceeds 8 agents → split or add granularity
286	- A new niche or capability emerges with no clean home → new sub-dept
287	- Two agents repeatedly collide on scope → may indicate sub-dept split
288	
289	### When to add a department
290	- Top-level dept exceeds 25 agents AND can split cleanly along function lines
291	- New strategic pillar approved by Yash (e.g., future "Sales", "Customer Success", "Legal")
292	
293	### When to add a pod
294	- Pods are reserved for engineering stack-specific clusters (pod-a / pod-b / pod-c)
295	- Other departments don't currently use pods
296	- New stack added → new pod (e.g., pod-d if AI-only stack ever splits from Stack A)
297

299	- Sub-dept has ≤2 agents for >90 days AND function overlaps with adjacent sub-dept
300	- Cadence proposes merge in monthly review

321	  - design-system → token

336	6. **MEMORY.md** — Add this file to Critical-Load-First section
337	7. **Roster sync** — Roster nightly recompute uses subDepartment for capability-gap detection by sub-dept

The org chart reads live data from the `/api/org-chart` endpoint (backend route at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Polyglot/src/routes/orgHr.js`). The endpoint calls `org.buildOrgChart(agentMap)` which composes:
- `~/.claude/org/registry.json` (per-agent records)
- `~/.claude/org/departments.json` (department metadata)
- Live agent metadata from disk (name, model, tools, description)

**JSON Fields Rendered:**

From registry.json per agent:
- `title` — Job title (e.g., "VP Engineering")
- `department` — Top-level dept ID
- `subDepartment` — Sub-dept ID (e.g., "pod-a", "public-pages")
- `pod` — Optional pod for engineering only
- `level` — Numeric level (0–8, maps to badge)
- `levelTitle` — Custom level name override
- `yearsOfExperience` — Numeric experience
- `status` — 'active' | 'probation' | 'pip' | 'pending' | 'retired'
- `reportsTo` — Manager ID
- `secondaryReportsTo` — Cross-functional mentor
- `tier` — 'leadership' | 'engineer' | 'analyst' | 'creative'
- `model` — 'opus' | 'sonnet' | 'haiku'

**Badge Format:**

(No "PROBATION" badge—instead, status field overlays a ring on the level badge.)

**Live Re-Read:**

The chart subscribes to SSE `/api/org-chart/stream` (WebSocket-like) which broadcasts agent upserts + task lifecycle events. The UI re-renders on `agent:upsert` events in real time. Static initial fetch via GET `/api/org-chart`.
